title: How to Style a Coral Chanderi Kurta Set for Every Occasion
excerpt: How to style a coral pink chanderi kurta set for day weddings, puja, office festive days, Christmas lunch and baby showers, with jewellery tips.
body:
A coral chanderi kurta set works for almost every daytime occasion: wear it with gold jhumkas and the dupatta on both shoulders for a day wedding or puja, with simple studs and the dupatta on one shoulder for an office festive day, and with pearls and soft makeup for a baby shower or brunch. Coral is warm and cheerful, and chanderi's gentle sheen makes it look dressed up without feeling heavy.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. This set is stitched and hand embroidered in our own Jaipur unit.*

**Quick answer**

- Day wedding or haldi: gold jhumkas, bangles and the dupatta on both shoulders
- Puja or temple visit: dupatta over the head or shoulders, minimal jewellery
- Office festive day: small studs, the dupatta on one shoulder, block heels
- Baby shower or brunch: pearls, soft pink lip and loose hair
- Christmas or winter lunch: a camel coat and a cream shawl on top

## Why is a coral chanderi set so versatile?

Coral sits between pink and orange, which gives it warmth without the drama of bright red. It flatters a wide range of skin tones, especially warm and olive ones, and looks lovely in daylight.

Chanderi adds the other half of the magic. It is a light, fine fabric with a soft natural sheen, so it looks festive but stays comfortable. The [coral pink chanderi kurta set with hand-embroidered yoke and cutwork dupatta](/products/coral-pink-chanderi-hand-embroidered-kurta-pant-dupatta-set/) brings these together. The embroidered yoke frames your face, and the cutwork dupatta adds a pretty, lacy finish.

If you want to know more about the fabric, read our guide on [what chanderi is and how to style it](/blog/what-is-chanderi-fabric-how-to-style-a-chanderi-kurta-set/).

## How do I style it for each occasion?

| Occasion | Jewellery | Dupatta | Hair and makeup | Shoes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Day wedding or haldi | Gold jhumkas, bangles | Both shoulders | Braid or low bun, bindi | Embellished juttis |
| Puja or temple | Small gold studs | Over the head or shoulders | Simple bun, no-makeup look | Easy slip-ons |
| Office festive day | Studs, a watch | One shoulder, pinned | Sleek ponytail | Block heels or loafers |
| Baby shower or brunch | Pearl drops | Loosely around the neck | Loose waves, soft pink lip | Ballet flats |
| Christmas lunch | Gold hoops | Draped over a shawl | Soft curls, berry lip | Ankle boots outside, juttis inside |

## How do I wear it to a day wedding or haldi?

For a day wedding, haldi or mehendi, go traditional. Drape the cutwork dupatta over both shoulders so the border frames the outfit. Add gold jhumkas, a stack of bangles and a small bindi. A braid with a few flowers looks lovely.

Coral is a joyful colour for these functions, and it does not compete with the bride. If you are going to a roka or engagement, our post on [roka and engagement outfit ideas](/blog/roka-and-engagement-outfit-ideas/) has more ideas for that day.

## How do I wear it to a puja or temple?

For a puja, keep things simple and respectful. Drape the dupatta over your head or shoulders. Choose small gold studs and skip the heavy jewellery. Slip-on juttis or sandals are easiest when you need to remove shoes at the door.

Chanderi is comfortable for sitting on the floor for long periods, and the soft fabric does not crease as badly as heavier silks.

## Can I wear it to the office?

Yes. For a Diwali day at work, an office festive lunch or a team celebration, a coral chanderi set feels polished. Wear the dupatta over one shoulder and pin it neatly at the back, so it does not get in the way at your desk. Add small studs, a watch and block heels or loafers.

If your office is more casual, you can even skip the dupatta and add a tailored blazer on top.

## How do I wear it to a baby shower or brunch?

For a baby shower, godh bharai or Sunday brunch, keep it light and sweet. Wear the dupatta loosely around your neck like a scarf. Pearl drops, a soft pink lip and loose waves finish the look. Ballet flats keep you comfortable.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Chanderi has a fine weave with a natural sheen, so it reflects light softly rather than shining. Hand embroidery on the yoke sits slightly raised, which gives depth in close-up photos. Cutwork on the dupatta looks best against a contrasting background, so let it fall over a darker coat or chair for pictures.

## How do I wear it in winter?

In the UK, Canada or the northern USA, layer for warmth. Wear thin thermal leggings under the pants, and a long camel or cream coat on top. A cream or grey shawl looks lovely with coral. Change into juttis indoors. For a Christmas lunch, add gold hoops and a berry lip for a seasonal touch.

## Frequently asked questions

**What jewellery goes with a coral kurta set?**
Gold jewellery looks warm and festive with coral. Pearls suit daytime events, and small studs work for the office.

**Can I wear a chanderi kurta set to a wedding?**
Yes, especially for day functions like haldi, mehendi and morning ceremonies. For evening receptions, add heavier jewellery.

**What colour dupatta goes with coral?**
The matching cutwork dupatta is the easiest choice. For contrast, try cream, mint or gold.

**How do I care for a chanderi kurta set?**
Dry cleaning is safest for embroidered chanderi. If hand washing, use cold water and a mild detergent, and dry in the shade.
